UserCloudProfile.title: UserCloudProfile
UserCloudProfile.description: Per-user cloud profile and synchronized G-Max Game Booster settings and options.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID owning this profile.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In or profile customization.

username.description: Unique gamer username handle (3 to 20 alphanumeric/underscore characters).

countryCode.description: Selected ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, GB, JP).

countryName.description: Selected country display name (e.g., United States).

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In.

photoUrl.description: User profile picture URL or local cached path.

bannerUrl.description: User hero background banner URL, preset ID, or local cached path.

gamerscore.description: Uncapped Gamerscore points calculated from total playtime and sessions.

dateOfBirth.description: User date of birth string (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD or Not Set).

selectedTags.description: Up to 4 premade profile tag IDs chosen from the 45-tag catalog.

isVerifiedDeveloper.description: True exclusively for the verified developer account Albertomiller747@gmail.com.

mostPlayedGameName.description: Display name of the user's most played game.

mostPlayedGamePkg.description: Package name of the user's most played game.

mostPlayedMinutes.description: Total minutes played for the user's most played game.

totalPlayTimeMinutes.description: Cumulative minutes played across every game session together.

totalSessionsCount.description: Total number of game sessions recorded across all games.

themeMode.description: App background theme mode (AUTO_SYSTEM, LIGHT_HUB, DARK_HUB, CUSTOM_COLOR).

reducedAnimations.description: Whether Lite Mode / Reduced Animations is enabled.

autoBigScreenLandscape.description: Whether Big Screen Console Mode activates automatically in landscape.

showControllerLegendBar.description: Whether the controller shortcut legend bar is shown.

suppressActivationWarning.description: Whether boost activation confirmation dialog is suppressed.

appliedOptionIds.description: Bounded list of applied boost and tweak option IDs.

hudEnabled.description: Whether the floating in-game performance HUD is enabled.

hudShowFps.description: Whether EFPS is shown in the floating HUD.

hudShowTemp.description: Whether temperature is shown in the floating HUD.

hudShowBattery.description: Whether battery level is shown in the floating HUD.

hudShowTime.description: Whether match stopwatch timer is shown in the floating HUD.

hudShowRamPct.description: Whether RAM usage percentage is shown in the floating HUD.

hudShowClock.description: Whether current time of day is shown in the floating HUD.

crosshairEnabled.description: Whether tactical crosshair overlay is enabled.

lightbarColorHex.description: Selected controller lightbar color hex string.

recBitrateMbps.description: Screen recorder video bitrate in Mbps.

recShowTimerHud.description: Whether recording timer HUD is displayed.

recOverlayEnabled.description: Whether floating recording bubble is enabled.

recBubbleSizeDp.description: Floating recording bubble diameter in dp (28 to 64).

targetGamePkg.description: Last selected target game package name.

targetGameName.description: Last selected target game display name.

libraryPackages.description: Bounded list of user library game package names.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public worldwide leaderboard entry displaying only profile image, username, country flag, and Gamerscore without exposing private PII.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID owning this leaderboard entry.

photoUrl.description: User profile picture URL or cached path.

isVerifiedDeveloper.description: True exclusively for the verified developer account Albertomiller747@gmail.com.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the leaderboard entry was last updated.

UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Enforces global username uniqueness across the worldwide leaderboard.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID claiming this username.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the username was claimed or updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's personal profile, most played game summary, date of birth, and synchronized app/boost/HUD/controller/recorder settings.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Public worldwide leaderboard entries sorted by gamerscore descending.

/usernames/{usernameLower}.description: Global registry of claimed lowercase usernames to enforce unique handles.
